[P2] Preserve Surplus quota health through Chat terminal handling

When this handles a final Surplus 402 on `/v1/chat/completions` (for example, when OpenLux is disabled or cannot serve the model), it records `quota_exhausted`, but the Chat path does not pass `routed.paidFallbackErrorHealth` into `createMeteredTransportLifecycle`. `respondChatCompletionsUpstreamHttpFailure` then reconciles the reservation with the default `upstream_error`, overwriting the admin health state. Thread the delivered classification through the Chat lifecycle as the Responses path does.
